name: learning-physics-lab
description: Physics lab organism — a live gravity + wall-bounce simulation on a physics-canvas; Start/Pause/Reset drive a per-tick integrator that advances each body's velocity and position.

schema.name: learning-physics-lab
schema.description: Physics lab organism — a live gravity + wall-bounce simulation on a physics-canvas; Start/Pause/Reset drive a per-tick integrator that advances each body's velocity and position.

emits.description: startEvent prop — begins the physics integration loop
pauseEvent prop — halts the integration loop, freezing the bodies
resetEvent prop — restores the bodies to their initial config state

events.name: Start
events.description: startEvent prop — begins the physics integration loop

events.name: Pause
events.description: pauseEvent prop — halts the integration loop, freezing the bodies

events.name: Reset
events.description: resetEvent prop — restores the bodies to their initial config state

mode.label: Mode
mode.description: What kind of physics visualization to render.
mode.synonyms: oscillation, sine wave, sound wave, light, electric field, magnetic field, gravitational field, force, ray, lens, mirror, pendulum, swing, circuit, resistor, battery, current, projectile, bounce, gravity, kinematics, motion

animate.label: Animate
animate.description: Enable the canvas's own redraw loop (independent of the physics tick).

bodies.label: Bodies
bodies.description: Bodies or particles to simulate; each carries position (x,y) and velocity (vx,vy).

damping.label: Damping
damping.description: Fraction of velocity retained each tick, modelling air resistance.

showVelocity.label: Show Velocity
showVelocity.description: Render velocity arrows for each body.

restitution.label: Restitution
restitution.description: Fraction of speed kept when a body bounces off a wall (0 = dead stop, 1 = perfectly elastic).

constraints.label: Constraints
constraints.description: Links between bodies, drawn as connecting lines.

showForces.label: Show Forces
showForces.description: Render force arrows for each body.

shapes.label: Shapes
shapes.description: Extra declarative shapes such as field lines, rays, or circuit wires.

gravity.label: Gravity
gravity.description: Downward acceleration added to each body's vy every tick.

interactive.label: Interactive
interactive.description: Enable pointer interaction on the canvas.
